entities.summary: Serbian Orthodox Church, a political institution in Serbia during Serbian Principalities & Nemanjić Dynasty (1166–1331). Grew from Early Serbian Principalities. Led to the emergence of Sava and Saint Sava establishes the autocephalous Serbian Orthodox Church.
